decisions.reason: A perfect binder sits at the core of the firm's finishing portfolio, the industry's turnover growth suggests results meet aspirations, and a broad portfolio indicates slack to carry it, so problemistic search is unlikely.
The fully automatic binder fits the firm's stated push toward integrated automation, and in a growing market it likely performs at or above aspiration, giving no reason to drop it.

An inline/nearline booklet maker directly serves the strategic expansion into digital print finishing and is close to the established offer, so satisfactory results and available slack favour keeping it.
